The full analysis and measured table are the ruling record on #19491.

## What this card changes (text only, Tier H — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`; the maintainer merges by hand)

Five edits, one PR. Every edit is a charter sentence; ⛔ no script, workflow or product file is touched here (the C5 code demotion in `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs` is the spec seat's in-flight dev per its own report on the ruling thread; the patrol schedule and the CI self-test scoping are their own cards, filed with this one).

1. **R1 — `--pair` blocks only on definite rows.** `SKILL.md:649` today: 「开 PR `PM_SWEEP_REPO=仓 check-clause2-carriers --pair N` 0 才请审」; `references/contract-review.md:41` 「② 双载体已清,逐对机读 … --pair N」 and `:55`. Rewrite so that a non-zero `--pair` is a landing block **only** when a row answering a definite question is red (a review record exists / `Served-tier:` present / the two label carriers agree / claim shape) and **never** on C5 (the widening tell): C5 prints its `file:line` tells and the at-tier review rules on them. Wherever AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 or a reference makes `--pair` at 0 a conjunct of landing (the spec seat cites 「No seat judges this」), name C5 as excluded from that conjunct in the same PR — `git grep -n -- '--pair'` across `.claude/` and `AGENTS.md` is the census; if AGENTS.md itself needs the word, it is Tier H in the same PR.
2. **R2 — the rule line.** Add, next to the tooling rule ruling #202 B landed (PR #19462's 〈分诊座位职责〉 lines — read that branch, `claude/issue-19457-charter-product-only-queue`, head `36ab00aa`, and place the line so both PRs merge clean): 「只报告的仪器,报错不配 dev:猜意图的仪器(放宽 tell、巡查行)只印读数,误报由席位一句话推翻,⛔ 不立卡、不派 dev、不开 PR。」
3. **R3 (charter half) — the patrol anchor stops being a precondition.** Delete 〈执行座位职责〉 「每轮巡检第一判据:先读半状态巡查锚(`half-state-patrol.yml` 置顶 issue)」 and 「锚上点名本道卡/PR/座位贴的 H 行逐行处置,再做其余判据;锚行未处置 ⛔ 不开新派发」; replace with one line: 「半状态巡查只按需跑(分诊席每日全量对账可调用),其 H 行是读数不是前提;⛔ 不因锚行停派发。」 Mirror in `references/core-rules.md` if the precondition is stated there (grep 巡查锚 / 锚行).
4. **R5 — at-tier review: scope and shape.** In `references/contract-review.md` 〈复核归属与资格〉: (a) scope — the at-tier review is owed on a PR when its diff touches what ships to users or agents: `content/docs/**`, `apps/docs/**`, `CHANGELOG.md` / `.changeset/*` prose, published schemas (`packages/spec/src/**` non-test exports), rules text (`.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, `docs/adr/**`); a PR touching none of these (internal code, tests, `scripts/**` tooling) lands on CI + the seat's own read, ⛔ no second agent; (b) shape — the reviewer reads the diff and the card, and takes ③ (PR checks) from the head's check-runs via REST, ⛔ never re-runs the derived gate families locally (measured: 37 families re-run on two heads was the largest share of a 243k-token / 29-minute review, PR #19488 comment 5755178153); `Served-tier:` and the record shape are unchanged. Update `--template` guidance text only if `check-clause2-carriers --template` prints a line that contradicts (b); ⛔ do not edit the script here — report it as an out-of-scope finding instead.
5. **R6 — 〈仪器纪律〉.** A short section in a references file (`references/landing-operations.md` or a new `references/instrument-discipline.md` — the dev picks the file where the reader already looks, and says why), with exactly one pointer line in SKILL.md: hard gates only for questions with a definite answer (the governed register, the queue guard, CI tests, 「a review record exists」); an instrument that judges intent (widening, half-state) is report-only; a report-only instrument earns no dev (rule 2 above); a new gate, patrol row or ratchet needs the maintainer's sentence quoted on its card; the single tooling dev slot (#202 B) is spent on removals first; `dispatch-gates.mjs` is kept frozen (touched only when a workflow it feeds breaks). Quote the ruling as provenance in the section.

## Constraints

- **Line ratchet: ⛔ no ceiling raise.** `SKILL.md` is at 819 = the ceiling after PR #19462 (and PR #19488 lands it at exactly 819). Net SKILL.md lines must be ≤ 0: R3 deletes two lines and adds one, R2 adds one, R6 adds one pointer — pay the rest by tightening or merging existing lines (never by deleting a rule); `references/*` have their own ceilings (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` CEILINGS) — read them first and report exact counts. If a line cannot be paid, stop at that file and report the count; ⛔ do not raise a ceiling.
- **Collision:** PR #19462 (head `36ab00aa`) and PR #19488 (head `420bd091`) both edit SKILL.md / core-rules.md and wait for the maintainer's hand. Base on `origin/main`; keep every line those two PRs touch untouched; prove it with `git merge-tree --write-tree` against both heads (exit 0, no conflict markers) and say so in the PR body with the two shas. If an edit above must land on a line one of them moves, put yours on an adjacent line and note it.
- 120-byte line cap on charter lines; table rows exempt. Chinese for charter text (the file's language); English PR body.

## Acceptance (the PR body shows each)

- `git grep -n '0 才请审' .claude` = 0 hits with control `git grep -n -- '--pair' .claude` > 0; `git grep -n '锚行未处置' .claude` = 0 with control `git grep -n '半状态' .claude` > 0; `git grep -n 'C5' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` names it report-only; the R5 scope list and the 「⛔ never re-runs」 sentence are quoted from the file.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 0 with the per-file counts printed; `check:pm-widening-tells` (report-only after this PR, still run) and every family `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives, exit codes captured before any pipe.
- The at-tier review of this PR itself follows R5's shape (diff read + CI read; no gate re-run) — the director seat spawns it and says so on the PR.
